example.content:
const sourceName = '嘉立创示例_复制源_' + Date.now();
const sourceUuid = await eda.lib_Device.create(libraryUuid, sourceName, [], { symbolType: 2 });

const newName = '嘉立创示例_复制品_' + Date.now();
const copiedUuid = await eda.lib_Device.copy(sourceUuid, libraryUuid, libraryUuid, [], newName);

_source.title: 复制器件
_source.example.text.1: 2. 新建一个轻量器件作为复制来源
_source.example.text.2: 3. 复制到同一库，指定新名称避免同名冲突（分类传 [] = 不分类）
_source.example.text.3: 创建类保留现场（原件与复制品都留在个人库中供观察）
_source.params.libraryUuid: 库 UUID，可以使用 {@link LIB_LibrariesList} 内的接口获取
_source.params.newDeviceName: 新器件名称，如若目标库内存在重名器件将导致复制失败
_source.returns: 目标库内新器件的 UUID

title: Copy Device
params.libraryUuid: Library UUID, you can use {@link LIB_LibrariesList} APIs in
params.newDeviceName: New device name. If a device with the same name exists in the target library, the copy will fail
returns: UUID of the new device in the target library
